10. With 4 string, we craft 1 white wool.

12. Now we have the 4 string + 1 white wool we need for crafting 4 white carpets (since we need 3 white carpets to make 8 yellow carpets, we only need 1 additional white carpet).
13. We already crafted 1 yellow wool which was part of the 1 white wool we have.
14. Craft 8 yellow carpets using 8 white carpets and 1 yellow dye.

    - Craft 8 more white carpets.
15. Now we have 8 white carpets which can be used to make 8 yellow carpets.

2. Craft 4 string (1 stick)

5. Craft 3 white carpets (4 strings, 1 stick)
6. Craft 1 yellow carpet (1 white wool, 1 yellow dye)
7. Craft 8 yellow carpets (8 white carpets, 1 yellow dye)

The steps above ensure we have all required resources (including the yellow dye and white wool) to successfully craft 8 yellow carpets.
